verdict.rationale: Extend is a document-processing platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. It documents an official MCP server at docs.extend.ai/mcp, with sections on connecting from a client and limiting available tools, and its Agent Quickstart covers connecting a tool-calling client over MCP. The evidence is mostly page headings, though. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tool set, transport and authentication specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
